izzyondroid:com.sagiadinos.garlic.player.summary: Digital Signage Media Player based on SMIL standard
izzyondroid:com.sagiadinos.garlic.player.description:
Garlic is a W3C SMIL 3.0 compatible Open Source, and plattform independent Digital Signage Player . The player can be used online and offline. It works with SMIL compatible Digital Signage Software .
 Fast, powerful and simple Digital Signage Player: 
 supports different content formats like images, videos, html5, websites and widgets
 plays most codecs without requiring codec packages.
 no spyware, no advertising and no user tracking.
 protect your Digital Signage Solution against a vendor lock-in
 What is a Digital Signage Player? 
 A Digital Signage Player is an important part of a Digital Signage Solution . They have different feature sets and possess more intelligence than the everyday media players we use regulary.
 Players for Digital Signage play different content formats like images, videos, web pages as well as widgets. Furthermore, they support multiple monitors and divide screens into different zones. In addition, they offer reporting functions.
 Their playlists include complex structures and commands. Most players get their content from the Internet and some can even be administered remotely. Therefore they have to meet high security requirements.
 What is a SMIL Player? 
 A SMIL Player is a Digital Signage Player which uses the SMIL-Language for creating playlists.
 SMIL is a XML dialect which is standardized by the Word Wide Web Consortium (W3C). Exactly like HTML! The language describes playlists, time synchronizations, screen layouts, interactions and a lot more usable magic things for presentations.
 SMIL covers nearly every requirement for digital signage and can be extended easily. It is open documentated and can be used by everyone without licenseor NDA hassle.

fdroid:com.dhangofa.networktoggle.name: NetToggle
fdroid:com.dhangofa.networktoggle.summary: 5G network control with custom Quick Settings cycles, shortcuts and automation
fdroid:com.dhangofa.networktoggle.description:
NetToggle is a lightweight Android Quick Settings (QS) tile app for cellular network control. Create custom tile cycles, target one or both SIMs, build shortcuts, secure broadcast automation, and troubleshoot failures with detailed diagnostics.
 ⚙️ NETWORK MODES 
 Preferred 5G (5G/4G/3G/2G) : Recommended for daily use. Allows 5G SA and NSA, including UW, UC, 5G+, or 5G++ where supported, with LTE and legacy fallback.
 5G Only (NR Only) : Disables 4G, 3G, and 2G. Intended for 5G SA networks. Service and calls may fail on NSA networks or without SA and VoNR.
 Preferred 4G (4G/3G/2G) : Disables 5G while retaining LTE and legacy fallback. Useful for battery saving, reduced heat, or unstable 5G.
 4G Only (LTE/LTE-A) : Locks to LTE without 3G/2G fallback. Calls require VoLTE; carrier aggregation is controlled by the modem and network.
 Preferred 3G (3G/2G) : Disables 4G and 5G while allowing supported 3G and 2G networks.
 2G Only (GSM/EDGE) : Locks to 2G where legacy service remains available.
If calls or service fail in an Only mode, return to Preferred 5G or Preferred 4G.
 🔄 QUICK TILE CYCLE 
 Custom Sequence : Choose an ordered cycle of 2 or 3 modes.
 Live State : Shows the active mode with an Auto, SIM 1, SIM 2, or Both badge.
 Auto Restore : Optionally restores the last selected mode if Android, thermal management, or the carrier changes it.
 Efficient Refresh : Controlled checks avoid continuous polling.
 📱 TARGET SIM 
 Auto : Resolves the active data subscription and physical SIM slot.
 SIM 1 or SIM 2 : Applies changes to the selected SIM.
 Both SIMs : Offers mutually supported modes, applies changes to both, and reports partial failures.
If Auto detection fails, select a SIM manually.
 🪄 SHORTCUTS & ROUTINES 
Create up to 4 capability-aware actions with custom names, modes, and SIM targets. Use app shortcuts, pin actions, or integrate with supported OEM routines.
 📡 BROADCAST AUTOMATION 
Integrate with Tasker, MacroDroid, Automate, and similar tools. External automation is disabled by default and requires opt-in.
 🔌 REQUIREMENTS & PERMISSIONS 
 Root or Shizuku Required : Either must be active and authorized. Shizuku is recommended and can run through Root, ADB, or Wireless Debugging. Trusted forks may add start on boot, watchdog, or TCP mode. Root supports Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, and compatible su solutions.
 Read Phone State : Optional permission for faster native SIM and capability detection. Without it, privileged shell fallbacks are used where available.
 Run at Startup : Briefly clears stale tile state after boot or app update. No persistent background service is used.
Some root managers require manual authorization. Shizuku users must authorize NetToggle.
 🧠 SMART CAPABILITY FILTERING 
Evaluates device, SIM, and carrier information to hide unsupported modes. Both-SIM operation offers mutually supported modes. A registry helps hide legacy options on known 2G/3G sunset networks.
 🎨 DESIGN & THEMES 
Portrait and landscape layouts include guided setup and Auto, Light, Dark, and AMOLED themes.
 🛠️ DIAGNOSTICS 
Copyable reports include commands, exit codes, output, exceptions, execution state, and SIM resolution.
 💻 COMPATIBILITY 
Supports Android 7.0 and newer. Availability varies by Android version, OEM, ROM, modem, SIM, local network, and carrier.
 🛡️ PRIVACY 
 No advertisements, analytics, telemetry, or trackers.
 No Internet permission or transmission of user data.

fdroid:io.github.austriancanvassociety.f.name: Firehose Remote
fdroid:io.github.austriancanvassociety.f.summary: fire TV remote over your own Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud.
fdroid:io.github.austriancanvassociety.f.description:
Firehose Remote is an open-source, hand-rolled remote control for fire TV. It talks to the TV directly over your own local network — no ADB, no developer options, no account, and no cloud service in between.
Press Scan, pick your TV from the list, and type the PIN the TV displays. After that the app remembers the TV and opens straight onto a screen of buttons: a D-pad with OK, Back, Home, Options, Play/Pause, volume up and down, mute, rewind, forward, and Sleep.
Pair more than one TV and the app remembers them all — switch between them without typing a PIN again.
That is the whole app.
Deliberately absent: suggested content, watch-next rails, ads, analytics, telemetry, accounts, and Google Play services. The app has zero runtime dependencies — built-in Android platform APIs only, with no AndroidX, no Compose, no OkHttp, and no coroutines. It is built for F-Droid rather than Google Play, and the code is shaped that way.
Waking a sleeping TV: an idle fire TV stops answering its control API while still being visible on the network, which is why some third-party remotes report a TV as "not found". This app wakes it and retries the press instead of giving up.
Security posture, for the record: the app is LAN-only, and the TV presents a self-signed certificate, so the app deliberately disables TLS certificate verification — the connection is encrypted but not mutually authenticated. Anyone on the same network who holds the pairing token can drive the TV, so treat it as a credential. The alternative to this tradeoff — an account and a cloud relay — is what this app exists to avoid.
Requirements: Android 7.0 or newer, and a phone on the same network as the fire TV. The app asks only for what it needs to find and reach the TV on the LAN: internet, network state, and a Wi-Fi multicast lock, which is held only around a scan. There is no telemetry and nothing is sent anywhere except to your TV.
Source code is at https://github.com/AustrianCanvasSociety/firehose-remote

firefox-addons:924258.name: minerBlock
firefox-addons:924258.summary: Blocks cryptocurrency miners all over the web.
firefox-addons:924258.description:
MinerBlock is an efficient browser extension that focuses on blocking browser-based cryptocurrency miners all over the web.
This extension uses two different approaches to block miners. The first one is based on blocking requests/scripts loaded from a blacklist, this is the traditional approach adopted by most ad-blockers and other mining blockers.
The other approach which makes MinerBlock more efficient against cryptojacking is detecting potential mining behavior inside loaded scripts and kills them immediately.
This makes the extension able to block inline scripts as well as miners running through proxies.
Source code available on Github :
 https://github.com/xd4rker/MinerBlock

firefox-addons:3116231.name: Mister Download Manager
firefox-addons:3116231.summary: Hands your browser's downloads to Mister Download Manager, the free and open-source download manager for Windows, macOS and Linux: faster, resumable multi-connection downloads and a Download video button. Needs the free app.
firefox-addons:3116231.description:
Mister Download Manager (MDM) is a free, open-source download manager (GPL-3.0) for Windows, Linux and macOS. This add-on connects Firefox to it.
What it does:
• Takes your downloads, before Firefox's "What should Firefox do with this file?" dialog: files of the types you choose in MDM go to MDM, with the page they came from and your sign-in for the site, so downloads behind a login still work. Hold Alt while clicking to leave one to Firefox.
• A Download video button over videos on any page, including HLS and DASH streams. Drag it along the video's edge, hide it on one video, or turn it off for a site.
• Media on this page: the toolbar button lists the streams, videos and sounds the page has loaded, with their qualities, length and size. One click sends any of them to MDM. Copy-protected (DRM) media is marked Protected and never sent.
• Right-click any link: Download with Mister Download Manager, Download selected links, Download all links.
• Works behind your VPN or proxy add-on. Turn on "Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension" in the toolbar button (Firefox asks you once to allow it), and MDM downloads through the same proxy as Firefox. Turning it off takes the permission back.
• Says why. When a download stays with Firefox, the toolbar button tells you which setting decided it (its file type, the site, its size), and how to change it.
• Your choice, per site. Pause taking downloads, or never take them from a given site, from the toolbar button.
• Send to another MDM. Pair the add-on with MDM running on a server or another computer on your network, and your downloads go there.
• Always shows whether Firefox reaches MDM, and how to fix it when it doesn't. Works in Firefox and browsers built on it, like Waterfox, LibreWolf, Floorp and Zen.
MDM downloads over several connections at once, resumes after a cut connection or a restart, and has a scheduler, queues, a speed limiter, torrents and video downloads.
Requires the free Mister Download Manager app: https://misterdownloadmanager.com 
No ads, no analytics: nothing is sent anywhere except to MDM on your own computer, or to the MDM you paired it with.

firefox-addons:2976437.name: Comics / Manga Downloader
firefox-addons:2976437.summary: Download image-based comic/manga chapters you’re viewing in Firefox as CBZ, PDF, or ZIP — with auto-detect and page selection.
firefox-addons:2976437.description:
Comics / Manga Downloader Extension lets you save image-based chapters you’re viewing in Firefox as CBZ (default), PDF, or ZIP — directly from the current tab.
✅ Features
Export chapters as CBZ / PDF / ZIP
Auto-detect pages (recommended) to preselect likely chapter pages
Rescan after scrolling (useful for lazy-loaded readers)
Manual selection + filters by image dimensions and image URL
Files are packaged in correct page order (e.g., 001.jpg, 002.png)
🔒 Privacy
Everything is processed locally in your browser to generate the output file.
No images or browsing data are uploaded to any server.
⚠️ Limitations
Some sites may not work (or may produce blank/missing pages) if they:
use DRM/encrypted viewers
require restricted login access
block cross-origin image fetching or use protected blob: URLs
🧩 Source code & Support
Source code: https://github.com/saptarshimondal/Comics-Manga-Downloader-Extension 
Report bugs / request features: https://github.com/saptarshimondal/Comics-Manga-Downloader-Extension/issues 
Please use responsibly and respect website terms and copyright.

firefox-addons:2709434.name: Extended Color Management
firefox-addons:2709434.summary: Ever wish that Firefox didn't use color management when viewing images or video? Turn it off easily with this add-on.
firefox-addons:2709434.description:
For some specific applications, like video or image creation, the color management that Firefox does in concert with the operating system can be problematic, especially on macOS.
This extension makes it easy to flip the necessary preferences to make sure you are seeing images and video without any color modifications from Firefox or the operating system.
When color pass-through is enabled, Firefox does not make any changes to images or videos before they are passed to the operating system. When color pass-through is disabled, Firefox will use color management to attempt to correct colors in images and video.
This extension needs to "Access your data for all websites" so that it can add some JavaScript so websites can detect the extension. You can see the code we add at https://github.com/mkaply/extended_color_management/blob/main/content-script.js .

firefox-addons:830307.name: TabSearch
firefox-addons:830307.summary: Easy tab search & management. Get a keyboard-accessible search interface for managing your tabs.
firefox-addons:830307.description:
FEATURES 
* Keyboard-accessible interface for tab management (with customizable shortcuts)
* Extensive options for configuration
* Can search bookmarks and history
* List and restore recently closed tabs
* Visual count of the number of tabs open in a window
You can always read the latest version of the changelog at: https://github.com/reblws/tab-search/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md 
 Shortcuts 
All below except 'Toggle Extension' are customizable from the extension settings page. You can set up to two shortcuts for each command (except 'Toggle Extension')
Ctrl + Shift + F - Toggle extension (Windows/Linux)
Cmd + Shift + L - Toggle extension (macOS)
Ctrl + Backspace - Delete tab
Enter - Open selected tab or first in list if not selected
Up/Left - Select previous tab
Down/Right - Select next tab
Alt + R - Refresh tab
Alt + P - Pin tab
Ctrl + C - Copy Tab URL
Alt + Shift + D - Delete all duplicate tabs
Alt + M - Mute (only if tab is audible)
 Privacy Policy 
None of your browsing information is saved or accessed. Your browser's storage is only used to save your settings.
 Known Issues 
- If you see a shortcut that's set to the "Win" key it will not work, please disable it or set it to another binding
- Successive presses of the "Toggle Mute" command don't work. Switch to another tab then back before re-pressing toggling mute
The issues below are mainly Firefox issues:
- If the popup icon is hidden inside the overflow toolbar menu, the popup shortcut won't work.
- Input might not focus when the search popup is activated for certain users (Windows users mainly report this). Bugzilla Report . Fixed in FF60. Workaround for now is pressing tab after the popup opens (thanks recycler.fox for the suggestion)
- Popup activation shortcut: changing this is possible after FF60, still need to update the extension to support this
This extension is open source. Check out the source or contribute at: https://github.com/reblws/tab-search/ 
 New in 0.4.0 
- More tab management options
- Custom keyboard shortcuts
- Settings redesign
- Bookmarks and history
- Easier access to settings
- Check out the release notes or the changelog for more details!

apple-macos:1514739120.name: Ad Blocker ·
apple-macos:1514739120.description:
Ad-Blocker helps reduce ads and selected tracking elements while browsing supported websites in Safari. Minimize popups, banners, video ads, and other advertising content for a cleaner browsing experience. By reducing selected page elements and web requests, Ad-Blocker may also help supported webpages load with fewer unnecessary resources.
KEY FEATURES:
→ Safari Ad Blocking: Helps reduce popups, banners, video ads, and other advertising elements on supported websites in Safari.
→ Anti-Tracking Protection: Helps reduce requests from known trackers and selected tracking resources while browsing supported websites.
→ Page Loading Support: By reducing selected advertising elements and web requests, Ad-Blocker may help supported webpages load with fewer unnecessary resources.
→ Reduced Content Downloads: May help reduce unnecessary content downloads when supported filtering rules are active.
→ Video Ad Filtering: Helps reduce interruptions from video ads on supported websites in Safari.
→ Privacy Filter Lists: Enable supported filtering rules designed to reduce selected trackers, social media elements, and third-party web resources.
→ Web Resource Filtering: Apply supported rules to block selected unwanted web resources while browsing.
→ Adult Content Filtering: Helps block selected adult-content websites using supported filtering rules.
→ Language and Region Filters: Enable ad filtering rules for supported languages and regions.
→ Custom Block List: Create custom filtering rules for selected websites and terms.
DISCLAIMER:
Ad-Blocker is not guaranteed to block all ads, trackers, websites, or web content. Results may vary depending on website implementation, Safari limitations, enabled filters, and applied filtering rules.
Privacy Policy: https://www.pixsterstudio.com/legal-policies/ad-blocker/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://www.pixsterstudio.com/legal-policies/ad-blocker/terms-of-use
